nvidium.options.region_keep_distance.too:
How far to keep GPU terrain after Sodium unloads a chunk.
Vanilla: drop GPU mesh near vanilla render distance.
N chunks: keep explored mesh in VRAM out to N chunks.
Keep All: keep until VRAM is full.
With disk persistence, quit/rejoin reloads this mesh from the world folder.
Saves Nvidium terrain meshes to the world folder and reloads them after quit.
Stored at <save>/nvidium-persistent/. Delete that folder to wipe the cache.
nvidium.options.enable_lod.name: LOD terrain
nvidium.options.enable_lod.tooltip:
Past LOD start distance, only coarse LOD cubes are drawn.
Full Sodium/Nvidium mesh is limited to that radius so it cannot sit on top of LOD.
nvidium.options.lod_start_chunks.name: LOD start distance
nvidium.options.lod_start_chunks.tooltip:
Radius of full-quality mesh, in chunks.
Inside: Sodium/Nvidium full mesh only.
Outside: LOD only (no full mesh overlay).
Raise this if you want detail farther; lower it to force LOD sooner.
nvidium.options.automatic_memory_limit.t: Automatically determines the memory limit to set given the amount of available vram on your system (Close and reopen settings to edit the max memory)
nvidium.options.max_gpu_memory.name: Max gpu memory
nvidium.options.max_gpu_memory.tooltip: Max gpu memory allowed, will start to cull chunks if this limit is hit
nvidium.options.translucency_sorting.too:
Translucency sorting level, each level has different performance impact and visual quality. 
None:No translucency sorting, no impact, can look quite bad
Sections: Section level translucency sorting, brings translucency to the same level as sodium, minimal impact
Quads: Incremental sorting, sorts geometry correctly over multiple frames, can cause visual weirdness while sorting
Sodium: rely on sodium translucency sorting
nvidium.options.use_sodium_vertex_format: Uses sodium vertex format, less performant and uses more VRAM, may fixes issues with some mods
nvidium.options.cull_degenerate_triangle: Cull degenerate triangles for better performance
nvidium.options.statistics_level.name: Statistics Level
nvidium.options.statistics_level.tooltip: Statistics logging level, tracks the visibility count of cull layers
nvidium.options.render_fog.name: Render Fog
